av_contract.pass_condition: exact duration within 1 frame, continuous audio, no missing/duplicate terminal frames

identity.pass_condition: no visible identity drift, face geometry remains the same character across every shot

singing.pass_condition: mouth and jaw read as deliberate singing; closures/openings match phrase activity; no rubbery pops, frozen mouth, or unrelated motion

eyes.pass_condition: blinks are sparse, complete, smooth and do not resemble local image collapse

head_body.pass_condition: movement has phrase intent; no random wobble, puppet jitter, sliding torso or floating silhouette

lute_right_hand.pass_condition: right hand remains anatomically attached, crosses a plausible strum path and never visibly detaches/duplicates

lute_left_hand.pass_condition: left hand stays in believable contact with neck/fret area; no floating or geometric tearing

seated_read.pass_condition: in master/medium shots the bard reads as physically seated on the stage, with coherent lower-body occlusion/contact

matte_composite.pass_condition: no obvious halo, brown-background remnants, clipped hood/arms/lute, edge chatter, or light mismatch

environment.pass_condition: tavern reads as intentional medieval inn; real/PBR materials; no magenta missing textures, modern concert cues, or obvious primitive blockout

camera_edit.pass_condition: cuts do not land inside blink, maximum mouth opening or strum contact peak; each shot has a clear storytelling purpose

viewer_uncanny.pass_condition: full-speed review produces no moment where a normal viewer is likely to notice 'something is wrong' before noticing the performance

repair_rule: If one hard gate fails, repair only the responsible subsystem/block and re-run integration QA; do not regenerate proven subsystems.
promotion_rule: Golden slice may be promoted only after two consecutive integrated renders pass the same hard gates without new regressions.
